title: Kartik Aaryan's Captain India Begins London Shoot on September 1
excerpt: The Chak De! India director Shimit Amin helms the action drama inspired by India's wartime evacuation mission, with an August 2027 theatrical release locked in.
body:
• Kartik Aaryan's action drama Captain India begins principal photography in London on September 1, 2026, with filming expected to wrap by the end of October.
  • The film is directed by Shimit Amin, best known for Chak De! India, and is inspired by India's real-life evacuation of citizens from a war-torn country.
  • Produced by T-Series' Bhushan Kumar and Baweja Studio, the film is set for an August 13, 2027 theatrical release during the Independence Day weekend.
  • Aaryan recently underwent knee surgery after an on-set injury but the London schedule remains on track.

From Announcement to Action

Five years after it was first announced, Captain India is finally going before cameras. The action drama starring Kartik Aaryan will begin principal photography in London on September 1, with the first schedule expected to run through October, the producers confirmed on Saturday.

https://x.com/Variety/status/2093556769649832343

The film has had a turbulent journey to the set. Originally announced in 2021 with director Hansal Mehta attached and Ronnie Screwvala's RSVP producing alongside Baweja Studios, the project went through a significant creative overhaul. Shimit Amin, who directed Shah Rukh Khan in the iconic Chak De! India, now helms the revived version. T-Series' Bhushan Kumar has come on board as producer, with Baweja Studio, Dopamine Studios, and S B Films rounding out the production team.

India's Wartime Rescue on Screen

Captain India draws from the true events of India's evacuation missions in conflict zones — operations that have brought thousands of Indian citizens home from war-torn countries. Aaryan plays a pilot at the center of a dangerous rescue mission, in what the makers describe as an emotionally charged story built around a large-scale humanitarian operation.

The screenplay, developed by Nash Vazifdar, Sanchit Gupta, and Priyadarshee Shrivastava, aims to balance blockbuster action sequences with the human drama of civilians trapped in a conflict zone. The film is also expected to feature an ensemble cast, though details beyond Aaryan and recently confirmed co-star Parvathy Thiruvothu have not been announced.

Aaryan's Recovery and Ambition

The London schedule comes as Aaryan recovers from knee surgery following an injury sustained while filming an action sequence for Kabir Khan's upcoming sports drama. His spokesperson confirmed the surgery was successful and the actor is resting at home, with the Captain India start date unchanged.

For Aaryan, the project represents a deliberate shift toward more ambitious, physically demanding roles. Having built his career largely on romantic comedies and lighter fare, he has increasingly gravitated toward content-driven films. Captain India, with its aviation setting and rescue-mission narrative, marks his most scale-intensive project to date.

Independence Day 2027 Release

The film is targeting a theatrical release on August 13, 2027, placing it squarely in the Independence Day weekend frame — a slot that has historically rewarded patriotic and action-driven narratives in Hindi cinema. With Shimit Amin's track record of national-spirit storytelling and Aaryan's commercial pull, Captain India is being positioned as one of next year's marquee releases.

The London shoot beginning September 1 will now set the film's production timeline in motion toward that 2027 date.
